name: c-embrace
prompt: Use <image1> as the exact character reference for Momo: preserve the same warm apricot tadpole body, cream belly stripe, coral three-lobed gill fronds on both sides, dark teal eyes, cheeks, friendly face and flat contour-free shape language. Create a polished 1024 by 1024 mobile app icon for a German health and weight-loss app for two partners named Gemeinsam leichter. Full-bleed square artwork with all important content safely inside the central 70 percent for iOS and Android masks.
